name: Group of Stacks (gstack)
definition: A gstack G represents a rectangular region of stacks S with the same number of intervals n and identical sequence of attribute values a1, a2, ..., an. It covers a rectangle [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in the xy-plane.
summary: A gstack is a compact data structure that compresses sparse volume data by storing identical attribute sequences for rectangular stack regions while encoding varying geometry as non-intersecting heightfields.
